transcript.text: Yeh la lo stone grinders paati chetan kustan kada ndi? Alant appde, Atomberg Genova Mixer grinder perfect ka upiyogu padutundi. Dinni course mode lo grind cheste, road lo nurin nette bandi texture ustundi. Inka dinni powerful BLDC motor, yalante katina main blending, chopping aina solubhanga cheya galdu. Inka dinni lo advanced safety features kuda unnai. Like no auto restart, inka jar lock abha gane inka detect outundi.
